title: Progress configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.ProgressAPI.Create, parsed. Every property is required, as the platform always sends them all: an omitted one is not defaulted and stays undefined at runtime. A default is the value an invalid one falls back to. Generated by scripts/docs-ai-generator/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

AnimateInitialProgress.description: Animates the fill from 0 to InitialProgress when the pattern is built.

InitialProgress.description: Progress shown when the pattern is built, from 0 to 100.

Progress.description: Current progress, from 0 to 100; values outside the range are clamped.

ProgressCircleSize.description: Diameter of the circle (CSS length); used by the circle type only.

ProgressColor.description: Color of the progress fill: a color name from the theme palette or a CSS color.

Shape.description: Shape of the progress ends: soft, rounded or none (sharp).

Thickness.description: Thickness of the bar or of the circle stroke, in pixels.

TrailColor.description: Color of the unfilled track: a color name from the theme palette or a CSS color.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
